other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating the frequency of categorical variables on the combined train and test dataset leaks the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline (TF-IDF, SVD, date extraction) and evaluates using 5-fold CV with LightGBM. However, it fits transformers (TF-IDF, SVD) and computes frequency encodings on the combined train and test datasets, leading to severe data leakage. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random split, relies on naive averaging for ensembling, and evaluates performance using only a single metric.
